clauses.text: Gemini is used only after a yes on the consent card

steps.do: Settings, Models: press g (Google Gemini, experimental) and read the consent card. Answer No first.
steps.expect: Nothing is sent to Google while the card says No.

clauses.text: A chat with Gemini answers and can use a tool

steps.do: With your key set by you (never in chat) and gemini chosen, ask a question that needs a tool.
steps.expect: The answer comes back and the tool is used.
